verdicts.why: The text sums up the season; in #12 Frank is held in Micro's hideout (Manhattan per Fandom), beaten by Rawlins for the password, and kills Rawlins after Russo secretly snips his zip ties.

Finding her mother happens at the Malus Residence, which Fandom only places in New York, not Hell's Kitchen; in #6 Jessica goes to Oscar's apartment in her building over his loud music and they sleep together.

value: Mary Walker drugs Danny on the subway, and Davos takes the Iron Fist from him in a ritual at Eden Towers.
verdicts.why: The theft is #4's event but happens on the subway and at Eden Towers (New York City, no Chinatown); the proposed replacement is also not in Chinatown, since the peace-talk visit is at the Yang Mansion, which Fandom places in Manhattan.

In #1 Danny drinks a drugged drink in Joy's office at Rand Enterprises and wakes strapped to a bed at Birch (Manhattan); Fandom's Birch page says Joy and Ward sent him there, and #2 is his stay and escape.
Lantom nursing Matt starts earlier; in #10 Dex in Daredevil's suit attacks the Mass at Clinton Church and throws a billy club at Karen, and Lantom dies saving her.

The hex's creation is shown in #8's real memories: Wanda drives to the Westview lot, makes the house, the sitcom town, the barrier and a new Vision; #4 shows S.W.O.R.D. finding a hex that already exists.
The spell breaking is shown in #1 and in the #6 flashback; in #2 Teen asks to walk the Road and Agatha learns he broke her out of Wanda's spell.

value: Inside the alien temple under the city, the Diviner releases Terrigen Mist that changes Skye, and Trip dies trying to stop it.
verdicts.why: The search for the city is earlier; in #32 the Diviner opens in the temple and the mist cocoons Skye, but it is a crystal shard, after Trip kicks the crystals, that kills him, not the Diviner.
The briefing says civilians are sheltering inside Roxxcart because of the hurricane, so the store is not visited days before it.
Maya comes back to Tamaha in #1; in #3 Vickie holds Maya and Henry at Henry's skating rink for Fisk's men, and on her way out of town Maya goes home and is confronted by Fisk.
Bruce says Tony bought him the place; what Bruce and Tony built together was the bar, not the lab.
Gravik and G'iah meet Talos at the National Portrait Gallery, then a cafe where Gravik threatens G'iah; Fury only meets Talos at a pub before they drive to Portsmouth.
Wikipedia's #42 'Scars' summary: Jiaying delivers Cal to S.H.I.E.L.D., then kills Gonzales and shoots herself to start the war; #43 is Afterlife falling for it.
In #8 Billy and Jen rejoin Agatha at the end of the Road, find it is a circle, and in the basement trial Jen performs an unbinding ritual and regains her powers.
The #2 K'un-Lun flashback is the duel, which Lei Kung calls for Danny before Davos concedes.
Not an error: in #5 Marc and Steven wake with Taweret and find themselves on her boat in the Duat, which is what the text says.

value: Wolverine escapes Sinister's followers and finds Ka-Zar, who frees his people, and Xavier wrecks the machine that stole their powers so the X-Men can defeat Mister Sinister.
verdicts.why: The X-Men are overwhelmed rather than fighting their way in, and Ka-Zar's help to Xavier and Magneto is Part I; Wolverine escapes from inside, so he does not 'break in' as proposed.
Not an error: in #15 Spider-Man fights the Kingpin's Insidious Six, and Connors reveals he is mutating further, which fits the text.
The Red Skull's defeat is #62; #63 opens after it, with the heroes entering Doom's peaceful New Latveria to rescue the Thing and defeating Doom after he absorbs the Beyonder.
